scope: Encoded capture image publication; not full product acceptance
defect: write_img removed the previous latest frame before copy2; copy failures also leaked encoded temporary files and could expose partial archive files.
change: Stage complete files on destination filesystem, publish latest with replace and archives with non-overwriting link; always remove encoded temporary file.

tests.red: Expanded worker test fails against d8a18f69 when the old preview disappears before copying.
targeted: real PNG focus publication for both cameras
tests.python_scope: 165 passes from unchanged full run, plus the corrected focus AST harness rerun. Only focus_frames_test.py differs between full-run and final manifests.

limitations: Not a fix for observed worker latency.
Atomic namespace publication does not guarantee durability across sudden power loss.
Archive publication requires filesystem hard-link support, also used by panorama publication; production media is on the Linux ext filesystem.
